title: observability: token+kv metrics, logging & dashboard enhancements; alert tuning
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Motivation: reduce noise from high-cardinality token-level alerts, provide actionable token/kv-level cost + latency visibility, and improve KV cache logging to aid root cause analysis for cache misses. This PR implements token-level and KV cache metrics exports, enhanced structured logs for KV operations, an updated Grafana dashboard with cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alert rules to match observed production distributions. Changes are backward compatible: all metrics use new "token_*" and "kv_*" metric names but also provide compatibility counters for legacy dashboards for 30 days. Checklist: [x] export token-level generation latency and cost per-request metrics; [x] add KV cache hit/miss counters with latency buckets; [x] structured logs for KV operations (caller, key_type, hit/miss, duration_ms); [x] new Grafana dashboard panels for token cost, token latency P50/P95/P99, KV hit-rate, KV miss latency distribution; [x] tune alert thresholds to reduce false positives (see alert rationale in docs); [x] unit + integration tests; [x] migration notes in docs. Rollout plan: staged rollout to canary fleet (10%), monitor token-latency and kv_miss rate for 48h, then gradually increase to 100% with rollback on >2x baseline errors or >10% latency regression. Related: ENG-4621, incident SUP-1187.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Left a few small nit comments on naming (prefer token_gen_latency_ms -> token_latency_ms for consistency). Also: how will OTC sampling interact with metrics?

Sofia Ramirez (author): Updated metric names to token_latency_ms and added a note about OTC sampling - metrics are emitted pre-sampling and a sampled_count label is attached to sampled streams to allow correct aggregation.
Mei Chen: Can we avoid high-cardinality label explosion from prompt_id? Suggest sampling prompt_id and only emit hashed_prompt_bucket for dashboards.
Sofia Ramirez: Implemented hashed_prompt_bucket label with 1000 buckets; added documentation and an env flag OBS_HASHED_PROMPT_BUCKETS to tune buckets.
Arjun Patel: Approved after verifying CI and reviewing alert rationale. Confirmed backwards compatibility counters exist and docs migration steps look good.
Liam O'Connor: Verified Grafana panels in preview and confirmed alert suppression window reduces noise on transient spikes. Approving.
release_notes:
- Add token-level cost and latency metrics with Prometheus exporters and dashboard panels.
- Add KV cache hit/miss counters and latency histograms.
- Structured KV operation logs (sampled) for better post-mortem analysis.
- New Grafana dashboard with token/kv cost & latency breakdowns and drilldowns.
- Tuned alert thresholds and suppression windows to reduce noise.
- Migration: legacy metric compatibility counters retained for 30 days; see docs/observability/token-metrics.md for migration steps.
